title: What's new in {{version}}
intro: A few changes worth knowing about:
items: Simultaneous changes to HP, death saves, spell slots, and character resources now combine correctly: if the DM deals damage while a player heals at the same time, both changes apply instead of one silently overwriting the other.
Adding or removing conditions (e.g. "poisoned") from two devices at once no longer triggers an unnecessary conflict prompt.
Fixed a rare sync issue where an HP change could fail to reach the cloud, leaving the character sheet stuck showing "Sync pending."
